desc: Read \(N\), \(K\), and the array, and compute the XOR of all elements.
Set \(r=\min(K,N-K)\), preserving positional distinctness even for duplicate values.
Enumerate all \(r\)-index combinations and compute each combination’s XOR.
Convert omitted-subset XORs to selected-subset XORs using the total XOR when \(K>N-K\).
Maintain and print the maximum candidate in the requested complete Python code format.
